caption: The drawing features three depictions of a circular object with a pin extending downward from its base, likely representing different views of the same item. At the top center is the front view of the object: a circular ring with a reddish-pink outer border studded with small rectangular elements and a gold or yellow pin extending vertically downward from the circle's center. Below and to the left, the same object is shown with a brown or purplish border, again with a gold pin. To the right, a side view displays the object as a thin vertical rectangle with the reddish-pink border visible on the edge and the gold pin extending straight down. The background is a plain light beige, and the artist's signature "WALT. N. K" appears in the lower left corner. The composition is centered on the page, with the objects spaced apart and oriented upright.
title: Stick Pin
